question: World Cup-winning goalkeeper Iker Casillas announced his retirement from football in August 2020. To which of the following countries does he belong?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Spain.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Spain’s World Cup-winning captain and goalkeeper Iker Casillas has announced his retirement from the professional game.**
 
• Casillas was included in the FIFA FIFPro World XI five times and was chosen as the best goalkeeper in the world by the IFFHS five times.
 
• With his first team, he played 725 games during 16 seasons in which he won 19 titles including 3 European Cups.
 
• Casillas suffered a heart attack during a training session last year and has not played any competitive football since April 2019.
 
• Casillas, who finished his playing days at Porto, won the World Cup and two European Championships during an illustrious international career.
 
• He lifted **five La Liga titles** and the **Champions League three times with Real**, making 725 appearances for the Spanish giants over 16 seasons between 1999 and 2015.
 
• Casillas **won 167 caps for Spain**, bettered only by **Sergio Ramos,** and was captain when they became world champions in 2010 and triumphed at** Euro 2008 and Euro 2012.**

• Spain:

 
 
• Capital - Madrid.
 
• Currency - Euro.
 
• Prime Minister - Pedro Sánchez.
